title: Swift SDK: apricitus-ffi, XCFramework, ApricitusData package
description:
`design/storage.md` §3.2 (`apricitus-ffi`).

## Steps
1. `crates/apricitus-ffi` (UniFFI proc-macros) with the `ApricitusLibrary` surface in §3.2: `open`, `call`, `keep_candidate`, `feed`, `file_put`, `file_path`, `subscribe`, `contract_json`.
2. `scripts/build-xcframework.sh`: build `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-apple-ios` and `aarch64-apple-ios-sim`; run `uniffi-bindgen generate --library`; `xcodebuild -create-xcframework`.
3. `swift/ApricitusData/Package.swift` with a `binaryTarget`, plus Swift wrappers generated from the contract (`Models.swift`, and a `Client` mirroring `client.models.<model>.<op>`, returning `Result<T>` with `data`, `errors`, `nextToken`).
4. `swift test` smoke: open a migrated library, list clips by collection `marine-band` (story apricitus-f4359a), create/get/delete a Crate, keep a candidate.

## Verify
```
xcodebuild -version
scripts/build-xcframework.sh
cd swift/ApricitusData && swift test
```

---
**Repo:** `~/Projects/Ripple`, branch `master` (don't switch).
**Toolchain:** `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH`; Python `analysis/.venv/bin/python`; web `cd web && npm …`.
**Protocol:** initiative `apricitus-e70662`: specs first; log with `kbs comment`; run **Verify** and paste the output tail; label `ready-for-review`; never commit, push, close, or deploy. Don't change visuals in `web/src/ui/*` (the web session owns them); data calls only.
